raw: I felt proud of a bookcase I made. I cut the shelves from leftover pine, and the top shelf was level on the first try. That was satisfying—getting it straight without having to do it over. But what really pleased me was that it held every cookbook. You think about making something that looks right, and then there’s whether it actually does the job. This did. Leftover wood, and I’d made something useful out of it.
